Exercise: Suspended Split Squat

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_lower_body

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- adductors
- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate to high

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- glute_activation
- quadriceps_development

Contraindications:

- condition: Knee instability, reason: High stress on the knee joint
- condition: Recent lower body injury, reason: Increased risk of re-injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Suspended Bulgarian Split Squat, equipment: bench or step
- name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge, equipment: bodyweight

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift, equipment: barbell or dumbbells
- exercise_name: Lateral Lunge, equipment: bodyweight

Instructions:

- Suspend your straps so the handles are 18-30 inches from the floor.
- Facing away from the setup, place your rear foot into the handle behind you. Keep your head looking forward and your chest up, with your knee slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
- Descend by flexing the knee and hips, lowering yourself to the ground. Keep your weight on the heel of your foot and maintain your posture throughout the exercise.
- At the bottom of the movement, reverse the motion, extending through the hip and knee to return to the starting position.
